name: Sármellék (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:1:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sármellék (a green shield with a white stork between reeds and a wavy stripe) above the name SÁRMELLÉK in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
